notes:
What's new

- Updates are now one click: WinPreview downloads in the background, verifies the release, installs silently and reopens itself.
- A proper update window shows the version, size and release notes, with Update now, Later and Skip this version.
- Install when I close, so an update never interrupts what you are doing.
- The update manifest is signed and checked against a key inside the app, and downloads only come from GitHub.
- Failed downloads retry automatically, and a failed install reopens the previous version with the error and a log.
- TypeScript files open as code, and progress, staging and cleanup no longer leave stray installers behind.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.3 - Update System v2: signed update manifests (ECDSA P-256), one-click silent install with relaunch, what's-new sheet with release notes, install-on-close, download retry and integrity verification, staged rollout and kill switch support, update log, and clearer failure recovery.
